title: Wiemer about (v2)
description: A brand story on off-white: a very large heading top left, the text in the left third bottom-aligned with a tall 4:5 portrait photo in the right third, which wears a small mono label. Heading letters rise in, paragraphs lift in, and the photo drifts gently inside its rounded frame.
notes: phones show the photo first, then the heading and text
motion is CSS scroll-driven; static HTML shows everything
